english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a situation or the facts of what happened.
This is the all-purpose choice for the general state of affairs at a particular time.
Use 情況 as the all-purpose noun for a situation or circumstances affecting an event.
This is the all-purpose choice for a possible or expected course of events.
Use this for the general situation or state of affairs, especially when circumstances are the focus.
Use this when context means the particular circumstances or situation rather than general background.
